description: This file contains unit tests for verifying that cost calculations and logging in the litellm project utilize the appropriate debug log levels. It checks that verbose logging outputs are set at DEBUG level for detailed debugging information related to cost calculations and batch processing.

methods.name: test_cost_calculation_uses_debug_level(caplog)
methods.description: Verifies that the cost calculation logging uses DEBUG level when verbose_logger is set accordingly, ensuring detailed logs are captured during cost computation.

methods.name: test_batch_cost_calculation_uses_debug_level(caplog)
methods.description: Checks that batch cost calculation logs are at DEBUG level, confirming detailed logs for batch operations.
